collection.description: An unfamiliar sail is reported far beyond the reef, but disappears before anyone else sees it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An unfamiliar sail is reported far beyond the reef, but disappears before anyone else sees it.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The lookout sees only clouds for many days.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Another distant shape appears, equally impossible to identify.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The villagers feel safer, though no threat arrives.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A fisher worries that suspicion is changing the village.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A lantern burns on the shore without receiving an answer.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A storm extinguishes the lantern, and the story grows in retelling.
